# DIARRHEA WITH SALMONELLA (NONTYPHOIDAL SALMONELLA)

For systemic febrile illness or typhoidal Salmonella, refer to Enteric Fever treatment recommendations.
[Enteric Fever treatment recommendations](enteric-fever)

Treatment is not recommended for mild or moderately severe disease.

## _______________________________________________________________________________

References:
Sanford Guide article: Gastroenteritis, Salmonella: Non-typhi
DOI: 10.1093/cid/cix669-Shane et al, Clinical Infectious Diseases 2017, 65(12):45-80
Up-to-Date article: Nontyphoidal Salmonella: Gastrointestinal infection and asymptomatic carriage
Therapy:
## Primary treatment

Hydration and electrolyte replacement

## Antimicrobial treatment for severe disease

## Inpatient

Preferred:
Ciprofloxacin 500 mg PO q12h for 7 days [R,DI]

If infection acquired after international travel or patient is intolerant to fluoroquinolones:
Azithromycin 500 mg PO q24h for 7 days [M]

For patients who are hospitalized or unable to take oral medications:
Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q24h for 7 days [M]

## Outpatient

Preferred:
Ciprofloxacin 500 mg PO q12h for 7 days [R,DI]
Non-VA order for above

If infection acquired after international travel or patient is intolerant to fluoroquinolones:
Azithromycin 500 mg PO q24h for 7 days [M]
Non-VA order for above

For patients who are hospitalized or unable to take oral medications:
Refer to the Inpatient Antimicrobial CDSS
